description: This file defines a SwiftUI view modifier to change the cursor to a pointing hand when hovering over a view, and restores the cursor when hover ends or view disappears.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI view modifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand icon on hover and restores it when not hovering.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view content with hover and disappearance handlers to manage cursor state.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor
methods.description: Extension method to apply the PointingHandCursorModifier to a view.
